decisions.target_truth: Keep noun award=prize/recognition, verb award=grant as judged due, and legal/arbitration award. Preserve award↔grant as a useful sense-aligned contrast: award foregrounds conferral on merit/judgment or damages, while grant is broader formal giving/permission.
Single awareness/knowledge center is correct; be aware of is explicitly presentation-merged into its fixed collocation and does not create a competing meaning.

Center away as movement/state away from a reference point, including removal/disappearance as a particle contribution. Keep continuous-action away in work/chat away as a lower construction/particle use. Do not attribute the full lexical meanings of phrasal verbs such as put away or give away to separate standalone senses of away.
Keep noun awe=profound respect/wonder often with fear and verb awe=fill with awe; current distinction is coherent.

Restore very bad/extremely unpleasant as the ordinary L1 meaning. Keep frightening/terrible as a closely related branch. Downgrade archaic/literary awe-inspiring/solemn 'awful' to reference recognition rather than Active learner prominence.
Keep clumsy/unskilful in movement or manner, socially/situationally difficult or embarrassing, and physically difficult to handle because of shape/design; these are distinct modern high-value uses.

Keep noun ax, verb chop with an ax, and figurative ax=cut/eliminate jobs/costs/programs. Add explicit axe↔ax spelling closure and make axe searchable/recognizable; Current search found no separate word:axe owner or existing spelling relation.
Keep rotational/geometric axis, coordinate/reference axis, and capitalized historical Axis identity. The case-sensitive proper-lexeme overlay cleanly separates Axis powers from common noun axis.

Center baby=very young child and ordinary extension to a very young animal; avoid a rigid birth-to-one-year/not-yet-walking-or-talking boundary. Keep youngest member of a family/group as an extension and unborn child/fetus only as lower contextual recognition.
Keep bachelor=unmarried man and bachelor/bachelor's degree academic meaning; both are high-frequency and clearly distinguished.

Preserve the genuinely rich map: body/rear noun, back/rear adjective, return/reply adverb, support/back verb, move backward, earlier/overdue adjective, and lower bet-on sense. Truth is rich here; scanability belongs to later Learning review rather than forced semantic deletion.
Keep personal/social background, visual/background layer, background information/context, and background noise/interference. These are ordinary modern branches with a coherent setting/context center.
Keep backward=directed toward rear, figurative underdeveloped/less advanced, and adverb toward the rear; current hierarchy is coherent.

Define bacon broadly as cured pork, often sliced and often smoked, with cuts varying by region/type. Do not restrict the truth definition to meat from the pig's back/sides that must be both salted and smoked.
Keep bacteria as plural of bacterium / microscopic single-celled prokaryotic organisms. Current main semantic center is adequate for learner use.

Keep bad=poor/unpleasant, severe/serious, harmful/bad for, bad at, and nominal the bad at lower level. Expand feel bad to include the very common emotional meaning feel sorry/guilty/upset, not only feel physically ill or in pain.
Keep physical badge/insignia and figurative badge/sign of a quality or status; deprecated verb badge remains outside the active map.
Keep badly=to a severe/serious degree and badly=poorly/in an unsatisfactory way; badly needed already captures the strong-degree use.
Single sport noun meaning badminton is correct and sufficient.

Restore ordinary noun bag=flexible container as the primary Active sense. Keep quantity contained by a bag and verb bag=put into a bag as secondary branches. Downgrade hunting bag/bag game to recognition. Core must not reference a deprecated main container sense while Active starts from derived quantity.

relation_truth.target_truth: Preserve the sense-aligned contrast: both can formally give something, but award often follows merit/judgment or a legal decision, while grant is broader formal giving or permission.

notes: Truth-stage artifact only: no Word or Relation semantics were mutated.
Truth richness and later learner scanability are kept separate: a genuinely polyfunctional word such as back can PASS Knowledge even if Learning later chooses stronger compression.
